Apply
Junior Full-Stack Software Engineer

Atlanta, GA
Description

Flexi Software is hiring Junior and entry-level Full-Stack Software Engineers to help build the next generation of our platform. You will work across C# services and modern web front ends built with Node.js, React, and Next.js, backed by Microsoft SQL Server, and you will build, test, and deliver enterprise-grade software for financial institutions.

We are looking for engineers who embrace an AI-empowered software development lifecycle. At Flexi, AI is part of how we design, code, review, test, and document. You will work with agentic tools every day, and you will learn to direct them with good judgment, verify what they produce, and hold the result to the standards our banking, insurance, and financial services customers depend on.

Your primary focus will be delivering our next-generation web platform. On a limited basis, you may also work on Flexi's legacy Windows desktop solutions in C++ and C#, which gives you broad exposure to how enterprise software evolves. This role is a strong starting point for an early-career engineer who wants to grow quickly, learn from experienced engineers, and ship real software at scale.

This is a hybrid position, working in person with the team in our Atlanta, GA office.

About Flexi

Flexi Software has been a trusted provider of accounting solutions for over 30 years, offering both cloud-based and on-premise software purpose-built for organizations with the most complex accounting requirements — multi-entity and intercompany accounting at scale. Our comprehensive suite includes modules like General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, Fixed Asset Management, Project Accounting, Workflow Automation, Financial Reporting, and Budget Software. Serving industries including banking, insurance, financial services, credit unions, healthcare, and business process outsourcing, Flexi is renowned for its robust features, flexible deployment options, and exceptional customer support.

 In January 2025, Flexi was acquired by Quality Standard, a permanent capital holding company  that acquires and grows fintech and govtech software businesses with a long-term ownership  mindset.  Quality Standard is actively investing in Flexi's people, product, and operations.   

Flexi's office is located in Atlanta, GA. Quality Standard is headquartered in New York, NY.   

Roles and Responsibilities

Build, test, and deliver full-stack features for Flexi's next-generation platform, working across C# back-end services and APIs and Node.js, React, and Next.js front ends
Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, including unit and integration tests, as part of every change you ship
Work with Microsoft SQL Server: write queries and stored procedures, design tables, and learn to tune for application and      database performance
Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily across design, coding, code review, testing, and documentation, and learn      to direct them effectively
Review and verify AI-generated code with care, owning correctness, security, and quality for everything you commit
Take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback, to build skill and uphold team standards
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release practices so changes move to production safely and often
Build with the security, reliability, and data integrity expected of enterprise financial software, including input validation, error handling, and audit-friendly design
Investigate and resolve defects, tracing issues across the front end, services, and database
Write and maintain technical documentation, including API documentation and developer notes
Partner with Product, QA, and senior engineers to turn requirements into shipped customer-facing software
Contribute on a limited basis to Flexi's legacy Windows desktop solutions in C++ and C#, while next-generation web platform      delivery remains your primary focus, and learn how the new platform integrates with these existing products and our DevOps environment
Grow your skills through mentorship, pairing, and regular feedback, and share what you learn about AI-assisted development      with the team
Requirements

  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent practical      experience, such as a bootcamp, internship, or substantial project work
0–3 years of professional software development experience; internships and strong personal or academic projects count
Working knowledge of C# and the .NET platform, including object-oriented programming fundamentals, and a willingness to      work in legacy C++ and C# Windows desktop code on a limited basis
Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with hands-on experience building applications in React
Experience or coursework with Node.js and Next.js, including routing, server-side rendering, and API routes
Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, with exposure to Microsoft SQL Server preferred
Familiarity with building and consuming REST APIs
Experience with Git and a collaborative, pull-request-based workflow
Active, hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools in your own work, with a clear sense of when to trust their      output and when to question it
A solid grasp of software testing fundamentals, including writing unit tests
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Clear written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to ask good questions and take feedback well

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, or Web API development
Experience with Vite, modern build tooling, and component libraries or design systems
Experience delivering web applications in a B2B software environment using modern AI-accelerated tools such as Claude      Code, Cursor, and Codex, including prompt and context engineering for coding tasks
Exposure to automated testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, Jest, Playwright, or Cypress
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and containerization
Exposure to AWS or Azure cloud platforms
Interest in or exposure to secure coding practices, including OWASP guidance
Experience with ERP, accounting, financial, or other enterprise systems of record, especially B2B enterprise software, and      prior experience in the financial services industry or financial accounting

Personal Characteristics

AI-curious and AI-forward; you actively use AI tools in your own work, enjoy experimenting with agentic workflows, and share what works
Rigorous about quality; you treat AI output as a draft to be verified, not a result to be trusted blindly
A builder; you like turning an idea into working software and seeing it used
Eager to learn; you ask questions, seek feedback, and improve quickly
Hands-on and persistent; you stay with a hard bug until you understand the cause
Security- and detail-minded; you understand that accuracy and data integrity matter in financial software
Collaborative and low ego; you work well with engineers, QA, and Product
High integrity and sound judgment; trusted with sensitive customer and product information
Positive attitude and sense of humor; work is way more fun with people you enjoy!

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

Fully onboarded to Flexi's codebase, tooling, and AI-assisted development workflow, and contributing confidently
Shipping production-ready features and fixes across the C# back end, SQL Server, and the React/Next.js front end
Delivering well-tested work that passes review with steadily fewer corrections
Using AI tools effectively and responsibly, with changes that are verified, secure, and understood
Contributing meaningfully to code reviews, tests, and documentation
Understanding how the new platform fits with Flexi's existing C++/C# Windows desktop products and delivery pipeline, and      contributing to them when needed
Developing a clear growth plan with your manager and mentor, with growing independence on well-defined tasks

Flexi provides excellent benefits including paid holidays and paid time off, a 401(k) Plan with company match, health and dental insurance, life and disability insurance, and a vision discount plan.

Location: Hybrid • Atlanta, GA area only

Only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Any offer of employment will be contingent upon positive criminal background check.

No phone calls, please. Principals Only.

Drug-free workplace. M/F/V/H EEO
